checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: ~10-second vertical video with intelligible English voice-over
must.why: Video is 16:9 landscape, not vertical; the voice-over can't be judged.

must.item: Narration explains sound reflects and returns
Visuals show sound traveling from source to surface and back
must.why: The wave goes out to the far cliff. The frames show only a wave line, with no clear bounce. By 7 s and 9.5 s the line points back toward the viewer, but the hiker is no longer in frame.

must.item: Child-friendly language, narration not cut off

must.why: Speech not available. The visuals only partly show the journey.

faults.what: Aspect ratio is 16:9 landscape, but the brief requires vertical.
The hiker leaves the frame after the first shot, so no hiker is shown hearing the echo.
The wave is a single static-looking ribbon. It does not clearly bounce off the cliff and return.
The camera moves away from the hiker, who turns his back and gestures instead of shouting.
No fainter second wave or visual echo repeats.

summary: The clip is a nice-looking landscape canyon video with a glowing blue wave, but it is not vertical, loses the hiker, and does not clearly show a bounce and return.
